The NY-10 Primary, by Election District

New York's 10th Congressional District — Lower Manhattan and brownstone Brooklyn — in the Democratic primary for Congress. Brad Lander carried the district over Dan Goldman. Broken out by Assembly District and Community Board, down to the election district.

Election Districts

NY-10 by community board

The district spans six Manhattan boards and seven Brooklyn boards. Each card is that board's NY-10 portion only. Tap to open the board's full page.

Manhattan vs Brooklyn

The two-borough split

NY-10 straddles the East River. The Brooklyn portion broke far more heavily for Lander than the Manhattan portion.
